info.name: List enabled payment methods and service charges

items.docs: Optional pre-step that returns all payment methods enabled on the account for a given amount and currency, including each method's service charge and total amount. CONFIRMED from public documentation.

info.name: Create an invoice against a gateway and get a PaymentURL

items.docs: Creates a MyFatoorah invoice against a chosen payment method (or an embedded SessionId) and returns a hosted PaymentURL to redirect the customer to (or to submit card details to for direct payment). CONFIRMED from public documentation.
